sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-1B, the first model in the MiniCPM5 series. It is a dense 1B Transformer built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 1B-class open-source SOTA.

sources.snippet: Deploy MiniCPM5-1B with llama.cpp llama.cpp is the recommended path for CPU / edge / consumer-GPU deployment. The released GGUF builds run on laptops, single-board computers, Apple Silicon, and Windows boxes with no Python at all.
